title: Strates
description: Hex in 3D, with gravity. Bridge your two faces of the volume by placing, moving or mining cubes — and set ambushes in caverns your opponent cannot see from their side of the board. Play hotseat, against an honest AI, or online with a friend in a LOB7 room.
controls: Click the ground or the top of a column to place a cube; click one of your cubes (side face) then a ghost target to move; double-click, press M or use the button to mine.
Each player sees the board from their own fixed side only — hidden cubes are legal ambushes.
Hotseat: pass the device between turns.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
